subject.title: feat(clickclack): session discussions — bound channels, side agent, lifecycle sync

question: Should the bundled ClickClack plugin be permitted to register exact-incarnation scoped grants that let its discussion side session read, inspect, and send only to its attached main session?
rationale: This is a durable plugin-SDK authorization contract and a user-facing external-channel feature; tests can establish mechanics but cannot choose the acceptable authorization and ownership boundary.

options.title: Approve the narrow scoped grant
options.body: Accept the exact-requester, exact-target, exact-incarnation model after reviewing the live proof and keeping the grant limited to the documented session tools.

options.title: Require a narrower plugin boundary
options.body: Pause this PR until the capability is exposed through a more constrained owner-approved SDK contract or an external plugin boundary.

options.title: Keep the provider but remove side-agent relay
options.body: Limit the feature to read-only discussion channels and avoid granting a side session access to the main session.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow scoped grant
recommendation.body: Accept the exact-requester, exact-target, exact-incarnation model after reviewing the live proof and keeping the grant limited to the documented session tools.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the prerequisite discussion seam and is the strongest available routing candidate for the proposed ClickClack and scoped-access design.
